Explains the materially visible conflict
Asks one recommended product-visible question

Asks the user to choose CSS or component internals
Implements both navigation systems

cases.initial_user: 给现有数据页增加一个可移动、可关闭、实时更新的浮动记录表，不做原型，符合当前项目风格。
required_behaviors: Reads concrete synthetic project files or runtime evidence and selects StableDataTable as the closest stable same-role visual baseline
Records the locked row density column semantics icon treatment and information order plus the allowed floating move close and realtime deltas inside the current task
Implements through the lightweight non-prototype path

forbidden_behaviors: Proceeds from generic project style or token claims without a concrete baseline
Creates a prototype baseline form durable baseline document or UI governance worksheet
Changes the stable primary or secondary synthetic table appearance for the new floating consumer

cases.initial_user: 实现一个通用的双操作流程页，要考虑 loading、empty、error、disabled 等状态，不做原型。
required_behaviors: Separates routine state copy from meaning-changing product claims promises policy risk legal and accessibility obligations
Authors routine labels help and recovery text from confirmed behavior current product truth and established terminology without per-string approval
Uses one primary channel for each fact and progressively discloses confirmation-only detail
Validates not-ready ready and confirmation-dialog surfaces
forbidden_behaviors: Renders implementation commentary as permanent product copy
Repeats the same not-ready empty or risk fact in titles banners warnings and disabled controls
Shows zero-valued details empty collections or confirmation-only optional risk detail permanently when synthetic product truth says they are conditional
Creates a copy authority worksheet or prototype for this bounded task

cases.initial_user: 在浮动面板和历史页面各新增一个数据表，复用当前稳定表格风格，不做全局重设计。
required_behaviors: Reads the stable shared default owner and all existing and new synthetic consumers before editing
Adapts the floating-panel and history-page consumers downstream through local composition a consumer prop or an existing variant
Leaves the shared default and stable primary and secondary synthetic consumers unchanged
Collects rendered regression evidence for both new and existing consumers
forbidden_behaviors: Changes the stable shared default merely for the new consumers
Validates only the floating-panel or history-page surfaces
Creates a parallel shared table standard

cases.initial_user: 整个产品的表格密度确实都有问题，这次明确统一重设计，现有和新增的四个合成数据表消费者一起迁移。
required_behaviors: Recognizes explicit authorization to evolve the single shared table baseline
Enumerates every affected existing consumer and bounds the migration before changing the shared default
Collects before and after regression evidence for all affected consumers and device classes
Records a usable rollback boundary
forbidden_behaviors: Freezes a proven defective baseline despite the authorized redesign
Changes the shared default before enumerating affected consumers
Claims completion without consumer regression or rollback evidence
Creates a second shared baseline

cases.initial_user: 只读审计这个合成的图书馆房间预约页为什么难用。不要改文件，不要做原型，先按访客完成一次预约的完整流程给出确切结论。

Treats a scheduler failure as a new booking step

Invents a storage-region choice before or after success without evidence
Flips the recommendation from one corrected step without replaying the complete journey
